info.title: Flix Backend API
info.description: REST API for the Flix streaming platform. Manages user authentication, profiles, playable content, Mux HLS streaming, TMDB metadata integration, watch history, personal watchlists (My List), and content dislikes.

tags.name: Health
tags.description: Service availability and health check endpoints.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: User registration, login, logout, and session retrieval powered by Better Auth.

tags.name: Movies
tags.description: Playable catalog lookup, regional playability checks, and Mux HLS stream generation.

tags.name: TMDB
tags.description: Proxy endpoints for The Movie Database (TMDB) search, discovery, and metadata.

tags.name: Profile
tags.description: Authenticated user profile retrieval and preference updates.

tags.name: Watch History
tags.description: Playback progress tracking and Continue Watching list management.

cookieAuth.name: better-auth.session_token
cookieAuth.description: Session token cookie set automatically after signing in or signing up via /api/auth.

bearerAuth.description: Session token passed in the Authorization header.

added.description: True if the record was added; false if it was removed.

get.description: Verifies that the Flix Backend server is running and responsive.

post.summary: Register a new user with email and password
post.description: Creates a new user account via Better Auth and triggers a database hook that initializes a profile record in the profiles table with default region "US".

400.description: Invalid registration data or email already in use.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
post.description: Authenticates an existing user and sets the better-auth.session_token cookie.

get.description: Retrieves the active session and user object associated with the current request.

200.description: Active session details, or null if unauthenticated.

post.description: Revokes the current user session and clears the session cookie.

get.description: Returns all playable content entries from the database, optionally filtered by availability in a specific ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 region code (e.g., US, MX, ES).

get.summary: Check if a title is playable in a region
get.description: Checks whether a specific TMDB title ID exists in playable_content and is available in the specified region.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 region code (defaults to US).

get.summary: Get Mux stream URL and playback metadata
get.description: Retrieves Mux playback details and the HLS (.m3u8) streaming URL for a playable title.

200.description: Stream metadata and HLS playback URL.

404.description: No playable content found for the specified tmdbId.

example.error: No playable content found for this tmdbId

get.summary: Multi-search movies, TV series, and people
get.description: Queries TMDB /search/multi. Returns an empty results array immediately if q is omitted or shorter than 2 characters after trimming.

500.description: Upstream TMDB error or internal server error.

get.description: Fetches trending movies, TV shows, or all media from TMDB for the given time window.

500.description: Upstream TMDB error or internal server error.

get.summary: Get popular movies or TV shows
get.description: Fetches popular movies or TV shows from TMDB filtered by region and language.

500.description: Upstream TMDB error or internal server error.

get.summary: Get top-rated movies or TV shows
get.description: Fetches top-rated movies or TV shows from TMDB filtered by region and language.

500.description: Upstream TMDB error or internal server error.

get.description: Fetches full movie details from TMDB including credits, videos, watch/providers, and recommendations.

500.description: Upstream TMDB error or internal server error.

get.description: Fetches full TV series details from TMDB including credits, videos, watch/providers, recommendations, and aggregate_credits.

500.description: Upstream TMDB error or internal server error.

get.description: Fetches episode list and metadata for a specific season of a TV series from TMDB.

example.error: id and season must be numbers

500.description: Upstream TMDB error or internal server error.

get.summary: Resolve details by TMDB ID (movie or TV)
get.description: Attempts to fetch movie details first, then falls back to TV series details, returning the resolved object with an added media_type field ("movie" or "tv").

200.description: Resolved movie or TV details object with media_type.

404.description: No movie or TV series found for the given tmdbId.

get.description: Returns the profile record for the currently authenticated user.

patch.description: Updates the geographic region code for the authenticated user profile.

example.error: region is required and must be a string

patch.description: Partially updates language, maturityRating, or isKids settings on the authenticated user profile. At least one field must be provided.

400.description: No valid fields provided for update.

get.description: Returns incomplete watch history entries (completed = false and progressSeconds > 0) for the authenticated user, ordered by updatedAt descending.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return.

200.description: List of in-progress watch history entries.

post.description: Inserts or updates watch progress for a movie or episode. Marks the item as completed when progressSeconds >= durationSeconds * 0.9.

get.description: Returns playback progress for all episodes of a given TV series and season watched by the authenticated user.

200.description: List of episode progress records for the specified season.

example.error: tmdbId and seasonNumber must be numbers

get.description: Returns all items saved in the authenticated user personal list, ordered by addedAt.

post.description: Adds a title to the authenticated user watchlist if not present, or removes it if already present.

200.description: Toggle result indicating whether the item is now added.

get.summary: Check if a title is in My List
get.description: Checks whether a specific title is saved in the authenticated user watchlist.

delete.summary: Remove item from My List by ID
delete.description: Deletes a specific watchlist entry by its primary key ID if owned by the authenticated user.

parameters.name: itemId
parameters.description: Database primary key (id) of the my_list record.

404.description: Item not found or not owned by user.

example.error: Item not found or not owned by user

post.summary: Toggle dislike status for a title
post.description: Marks a title as disliked for the authenticated user if not present, or removes the dislike if already present.

200.description: Toggle result indicating whether the dislike record is now added.

get.summary: Check if a title is disliked
get.description: Checks whether a specific title is marked as disliked by the authenticated user.
